info.title: Sprint 1 Smart Lab and Room Booking API
info.description: Sprint 1 backend with Microsoft Graph one-way creation, rescheduling and cancellation of confirmed bookings. Confirmed events invite the student; room and equipment availability remains managed by the booking system. Outlook credentials must be configured locally; sync status is independent of booking status. University SSO and durable database remain adapter integration points. Recurrence is deferred to Sprint 2. Demo authentication and memory data are local-development-only. All paths retain trailing slashes; request timestamps require offsets and responses use UTC Z. Identity includes university_email. Only users whose induction for the resource is verified and current may submit requests. Every request starts as PENDING_APPROVAL and holds its slot during a review window (pending_hold_minutes, default 1440 = 24 hours, Manager-configurable per resource, capped at the booking start). An Admin or Manager approves or rejects it within the window; if nobody decides, the system approves it when it still follows the rules (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) and rejects it otherwise (AUTO_REJECTED_*). Requests for time that is already taken or held are WAITLISTED in submission order and, when the time frees up, become PENDING_APPROVAL with a fresh review window. Induction evidence is always reviewed manually. Bookings must start at least 7 and at most 30 days ahead (MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS / MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS). Authentication and resource-specific eligibility are separate. Verified induction expires a fixed number of days after approval (QUALIFICATION_VALIDITY_DAYS, default 120, one term); reviewers no longer supply an expiry. Admin and Manager can query the audit trail of requests, approvals, changes and cancellations. The prototype seed has 2 labs and 20 independently bookable devices. A Manager has every Admin permission and can also configure booking policies and nominate user roles or deactivate accounts. Admins are students nominated by a Manager: they can book like students but cannot approve their own requests or evidence. Managers do not book. A Manager can mark a resource MAINTENANCE or CLOSED (new requests paused, existing bookings kept) and list or export every booking. Managers are created only with Add manager (POST /admin/users/managers/); a student becomes an Admin only when every induction is verified and current.

post.summary: Create a room or individual equipment booking request
post.description: Student or Admin only (Managers do not book). Requires a VERIFIED, unexpired induction for the selected resource through the booking end; otherwise 403 QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED (details.qualification_status, requirement_id), including while evidence is still PENDING. The local start date must be from today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 7) to today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 30): BOOKING_TOO_SOON / BOOKING_TOO_FAR_AHEAD (400, details.earliest_date, latest_date, min_advance_days, max_advance_days). A user who already has an overlapping active request for this same resource receives DUPLICATE_BOOKING (409); terminal requests do not block rebooking and different resources remain independent. If no APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (reason AWAITING_REVIEW) with review_due_at = hold_until = min(start, now + pending_hold_minutes, default 1440). An Admin/Manager decides within that window; when it ends undecided the system re-checks the rules and sets APPROVED (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) or REJECTED (AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT), reviewed_by SYSTEM. If an APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes WAITLISTED (reason TIME_CONFLICT or TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT) with waitlist_position. When time frees up (cancellation, rejection, expiry, rescheduling, an automatic rejection or a resource reopening) the earliest waitlisted request that now fits becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST) with a fresh review window, or REJECTED (QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED) if its induction is no longer valid. Only APPROVED creates an Outlook event. Undecided and waitlisted requests expire at their start time. HTTP 201 never means approved. Interval semantics are [start, end).

post.description: Admin or Manager only; an Admin cannot review their own evidence (SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN). Evidence is always reviewed manually. A VERIFIED decision sets valid_until to the review time plus the configured validity period (default 120 days, one term); it lets the user submit booking requests but does not approve any booking. A REJECTED decision requires a reason and rejects the user's undecided bookings (PENDING_APPROVAL and WAITLISTED) for resources requiring this qualification with reason_code QUALIFICATION_REJECTED and the same reason, releasing their slots and offering them to the waitlist. updated_bookings lists every booking changed. valid_until is not accepted in the request; sending it returns 400.

get.description: Admin or Manager. Without filters returns the manual-approval queue (PENDING_APPROVAL), as before. status accepts one status, several separated by commas, or ALL. Optional resource_id, student_id, since and until (timestamps with offset; returns bookings overlapping the window). Ordered by start time. Each item includes student (zID, name, email), resource_name and resource_kind.

post.summary: Approve or reject a booking request
post.description: Admin or Manager only; an Admin cannot decide their own request (SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN, 403). Decide within the request's review window (review_due_at); afterwards the system decides automatically. APPROVED is allowed only for PENDING_APPROVAL requests; it re-checks resource-specific qualification through the booking end and conflicts with APPROVED bookings and other active pending requests, excluding this request's own ID. A WAITLISTED request cannot be approved (REQUEST_WAITLISTED, 409); it moves up in order. REJECTED (reason required) may be applied to PENDING_APPROVAL or WAITLISTED requests; rejecting a pending request offers its time to the next waitlisted request. BOOKING_HOLD_CONFLICT (409) includes details.hold_until; BOOKING_CONFLICT (409) indicates an approved blocker.

get.summary: Audit trail of requests, approvals, changes and cancellations
get.description: Admin or Manager only. Newest first. Filters combine with AND. resource_id matches the resource's own records (for example booking policy changes) and records of its bookings; student_id matches records performed by the student plus records of their bookings, qualification submissions and account. count is the total number of matching records before limit/offset.

patch.summary: Nominate a role or (de)activate an account (Manager only)
patch.description: Active Manager only. Send role and/or active. Takes effect on the user's next request; a deactivated user receives 401. Managers cannot change their own role or status (SELF_MODIFICATION_FORBIDDEN, 403), and at least one active Manager must remain (LAST_MANAGER, 409). Every change writes a USER_UPDATED audit record with previous and new values. Existing bookings are not changed. Role can only move between STUDENT and ADMIN: MANAGER cannot be assigned here and a Manager's role cannot be changed (403 MANAGER_ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE; use Add manager, or deactivate a Manager with active=false). A STUDENT becomes ADMIN only when every induction is verified and not expired; otherwise 409 INDUCTION_REQUIRED_FOR_ADMIN with a message such as "Jane Doe (z1234567) must pass every induction before becoming an administrator." and details.missing_inductions. The response includes inductions and induction_status.

patch.summary: Open a resource or take it out of service (Manager only)
patch.description: Active Manager only. MAINTENANCE or CLOSED (reason required) stops new requests (409 RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with details.resource_status and status_reason), approvals and waitlist promotions; availability shows RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. Existing bookings are kept and returned as affected_bookings. AVAILABLE reopens the resource and offers freed time to its waitlist again. Writes RESOURCE_STATUS_CHANGED to the audit trail.

200.description: Updated resource and the bookings that still need a decision.

400.description: Unknown status or missing reason (REASON_REQUIRED).

403.description: Only an active Manager can change resource status.

post.description: Active Manager only (the Add manager button in people management). The only way to create a Manager: a new, active account is created with role MANAGER; no induction is required. The zID is stored in lower case and must not exist yet (existing people cannot be turned into Managers). Writes MANAGER_CREATED to the audit trail. Students and admins are not created here; they come from existing accounts.

403.description: Only an active Manager can add managers.

409.description: USER_EXISTS: a user with this zID already exists (details.user_id).

BearerAuth.description: Signed demonstration token expires after 3600 seconds. Actual SSO authentication is supplied by a future server-side adapter.

pending_hold_minutes.description: Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

status.description: Set by a Manager. Only AVAILABLE accepts new requests, approvals and waitlist promotions; pending requests that reach their review deadline while the resource is unavailable are rejected automatically; approved bookings are kept.

status_reason.description: Shown to students while MAINTENANCE or CLOSED.

valid_until.description: Set by the server when VERIFIED: review time plus the configured validity period. Null for PENDING or REJECTED. Bookings must end no later than this time.

effective_status.description: Current derived status, including expiry; the stored review status remains in status.

file_url.description: Private API path; Bearer authentication is still required.

file.description: PDF, PNG or JPEG, at most 5 MiB; validated by the server.

status.description: PENDING_APPROVAL is an undecided request that holds its slot until review_due_at; WAITLISTED is queued behind an earlier booking or request and never holds a slot; only APPROVED is confirmed. WAITING_QUALIFICATION is kept for old data only and is no longer created.

reason_code.description: Why the request is in its status, e.g. AWAITING_REVIEW, AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW, AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT, TIME_CONFLICT, TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT, PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST, QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, START_TIME_PASSED, CANCELLED_BY_USER, CANCELLED_BY_STAFF.

review_due_at.description: End of the Admin review window for a PENDING_APPROVAL request (same as hold_until). After it the system approves or rejects the request automatically.

reviewed_by.description: Id of the Admin/Manager who decided, or SYSTEM for an automatic decision.

hold_until.description: Historical hold deadline; use hold_active to determine current occupancy.

hold_active.description: PENDING_APPROVAL and hold_until strictly later than server time.

blocks_slot.description: True for APPROVED or a pending request whose review window is active. Never true for WAITLISTED.

waitlist_position.description: 1-based place among waitlisted requests overlapping this one on the same resource, in submission order. Null unless WAITLISTED.

hold_until.description: Latest blocking hold deadline for TEMPORARILY_HELD; otherwise null.

held_by_me.description: True only when all blocking holds belong to the current user.

requested_by_me.description: True when the current user already has an overlapping active request for this resource; clients must not submit it again.

can_request.description: True only for a Student/Admin whose induction for this resource is VERIFIED and current, while the resource is AVAILABLE.

qualification_status.description: Current resource eligibility; request submission additionally checks validity through the selected end time.

earliest_date.description: First local date a booking may start on (today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS).

latest_date.description: Last local date a booking may start on (today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS).

sso_connected.description: Always false in Sprint 1; actual school SSO is not integrated.

configured.description: Local configuration exists; does not prove valid Graph authorization.

pending_hold_minutes.description: Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

Admin review window in minutes (the column name is kept for the database). A new or promoted PENDING_APPROVAL request holds its slot until min(start, now + this value); if no Admin/Manager decides by then, the system approves it when it still follows the rules and rejects it otherwise. Default 1440 (24 hours); 1-20160.

actor_id.description: User UUID, or SYSTEM for automatic time processing and calendar sync.

action.description: For example BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_APPROVED, BOOKING_REJECTED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_REEVALUATED, BOOKING_TIME_PROCESSED, QUALIFICATION_SUBMITTED, QUALIFICATION_VERIFIED, QUALIFICATION_REJECTED, RESOURCE_BOOKING_POLICY_UPDATED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_SUCCEEDED, OUTLOOK_SYNC_FAILED, DEMO_STUDENT_CREATED.

details.description: Action-specific values such as status, reason_code, reason, old/new times or valid_until.

actor.description: Null for SYSTEM or an unknown user.

active.description: false locks the account out on its next request; true restores it.

reason.description: Required for MAINTENANCE and CLOSED; shown to students. Ignored for AVAILABLE.

affected_bookings.description: Future approved or undecided bookings on this resource, kept as they are so the Manager can decide whether to cancel them (POST /bookings/{id}/cancel/ marks them CANCELLED_BY_STAFF).

inductions.description: Every induction requirement with this person's current status.

induction_status.description: VERIFIED only when every induction is verified and not expired; required before a student can become an Admin.
